subject: [New Feature] Customizable Avatars 👨🏼‍🎨
snippet:
Change up Synthesia avatars with your brand's colors and logo...
 
 Hey Zain,
 
 You can now customize avatars with your brand's colors!
 
 This means you can craft consistent avatars for particular uses—all with their own true ✨ aesthetic ✨ that cap
